reading.title: Plastic and progress
reading.text: Plastic was once seen as a symbol of progress. Today, it is a major cause of environmental degradation. Most plastic takes centuries to degrade, and even then it only breaks into smaller pieces. Some countries have chosen an aggressive approach, banning single-use bags overnight. Others prefer gradual change, taxing plastic and helping companies upgrade their packaging. Meanwhile, young graduates are starting businesses that make biodegradable alternatives from seaweed and rice husks.
